title: Article 1 Article 1  (1) Private rights must be congruent with the public welfare.
statute_text:
Article 1 Article 1  (1) Private rights must be congruent with the public welfare.
(2) The exercise of rights and performance of duties must be done in good faith.
(3) Abuse of rights is not permitted.
(Standards for Construction)
